title: aspidium fragrans
intro: Aspidium fragrans, commonly known as the Himalayan Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The health benefits of Aspidium fragrans include its ability to alleviate fever, soothe digestive issues, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
